correctness.rationale: The upper and lower bounds reconstruct exactly. The continuous surjection \(\Psi:\Delta_{m-1}\times K^m\to\mathcal M_{\le m}(K)\) intertwines \(\mathrm{id}\times T^{\times m}\) with \(T_*\), so factor monotonicity and the compact product entropy formula give the upper bound \(m h_{\mathrm{top}}(T|_K)\). For the lower bound, binary weights \(2^{i-1}/(2^m-1)\) have distinct subset sums, so \(\Phi_m(x)=\sum_i a_i\delta_{x_i}\) remains injective even when coordinates collide; its image is a compact invariant subsystem conjugate to \(T^{\times m}\). The argument remains valid when the entropy is infinite.
